The Prophet's heart was washed with Zamzam, once as a boy; he rode al-Buraq to Jerusalem, met prophets in the heavens, and fifty daily prayers were reduced to five.
When Quraysh denied him, the Prophet was in the Hatim and Allah raised Bait-ul-Maqdis before him, so he described its features while looking at it.

Questioned by Quraysh about his Night Journey, the Prophet saw Bait-ul-Maqdis raised before him and led the prophets in prayer; at Sidrat-ul-Muntaha he received five prayers and al-Baqara's closing verses.
On the night journey, offered wine and milk, the Prophet took the milk; Gabriel said he was guided to the true nature and wine would have misled his Umma.
